issues.title: Feature request: W17 owner console (Add app and patch decisions from Pages)
issues.body:
Planned as W17, in phases. Design: docs/review/w15g-close/plan/CONSOLE-W17.md.

- Pages builds GitHub issue-form links; the owner submits on GitHub (Pages never writes and holds no token).
- Tests run for anyone; only the owner's submission makes a ready pull request; merges stay with the owner.
- The note field is saved as a dated decision record, with an optional lesson flag.

issues.title: Feature request: Android Auto apps
issues.body:
Not started. No Android Auto package (com.google.android.projection.gearhead) is a target, and no provider is proven for it. Before any build: an exact target and store variant, live provider evidence for that package, a signature and privilege risk review (Android Auto may refuse re-signed apps), and a phone plus head-unit test plan. Notes: docs/review/w15g-close/plan/CONSOLE-W17.md, section Android Auto.
